title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03)
summary: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) is an associate-level certification for practitioners who build and operate on AWS. The exam is organised into 4 content domains: Design Secure Architectures (30%), Design Resilient Architectures (26%), Design High-Performing Architectures (24%), Design Cost-Optimized Architectures (20%). It is delivered as 50 scored questions and 15 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 720 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Design Secure Architectures: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Design Resilient Architectures: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 2 task statement(s).
Design High-Performing Architectures: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 5 task statement(s).
Design Cost-Optimized Architectures: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
